ttm.note: Netflix Q3 2026 results were released in an 8-K on 2026-10-20 (accession 0001065280-26-000290, Items 2.02/9.01), but no Q3 10-Q appears in EDGAR submissions as of 2026-10-20, so the TTM base is the June 30 2026 10-Q. Options: the 10-Q does not disclose weighted-average remaining life or aggregate intrinsic value (the 10-K gave 4.79 years and $7,430.160m at Dec 2025); both left null rather than carried. H1 2026 other income of ~$2.9bn (WBD termination-related) is below operating income and does not affect it. Post-period (not in June balance sheet): $1bn 5.250% notes due 2036 issued 2026-07-22 (8-K 0001193125-26-312575) to repay the $1bn 4.375% notes due Nov 2026 (current at June). Debt is carrying value; principal at par $14,372m, fair value $14,605m. Content liabilities not treated as debt. Share repurchases continued after June 30 (not reflected).

notes: All shares are post the 10-for-1 forward split completed 2025-11-14 (10-K and 10-Q are retroactively adjusted).
Source figures are filed in thousands of USD and converted to millions here.
No Q3 2026 10-Q filed on or before 2026-10-20; the 2026-10-20 8-K earnings release was not used for any balance-sheet value.
